policy: Dhamir forms are learned through Quranic pattern recognition, not by forcing a full paradigm table at the beginning. No CEFR claim.

laterExposure.note: introduced when sufficient Quranic evidence and competency sequence permit
not forced into K05 core if evidence density is pedagogically weak

note: K05 does not require memorizing the traditional full 14-pronoun table. The table may be provided later as a summary after recognition is established. Functions such as mubtada, taukid, fasl, and object pronoun إياك are outside the K05 target unless used only as contrast.
